i < sdim->rank; i++) H5F_DECODE_LENGTH(f, p, sdim->size[i]);","note":"The decoder consumes rank-dependent length fields from the raw buffer; a malformed rank/size combination can drive the later out-of-bounds read in the message parser."},{"step":9,"file":"src/H5Osdspace.c","function":"H5O__sdspace_decode","line":156,"var":"sdim->nelem","code":"for (i = 0, sdim->nelem = 1; i < sdim->rank; i++) sdim->nelem *= sdim->size[i];","note":"The parsed dimensions are combined into an element count, completing propagation of attacker-controlled metadata into the dataspace object used by later HDF5 code."}]
